description: This file defines a React functional component 'LoggingSettingsView' used for rendering logging configurations and disabled callbacks in a dashboard UI. It includes internal interfaces, utility functions for display logic, and JSX for UI layout.

methods.name: getLoggingDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name for a callback based on its internal callback name.

methods.name: getEventTypeColor
methods.description: Maps callback types to color labels for UI badges.

methods.name: getEventTypeLabel
methods.description: Maps callback types to user-friendly labels.
